ApplyRefund4Distribution.title: Refund request for distribution purchase order
ApplyRefund4Distribution.description:
Obtain refund application initialization information through the initApplyRefund4Distribution API and initiate a refund or return-and-refund request. This API does not support exchange requests.  

Note:  
1. If the refund request is denied by the seller (disputeStatus is 6 when queried via the queryRefundApplicationDetail4Distribution API), you must first cancel the refund request (via the cancelRefund API) before submitting a new one.  
2. During the pre-delivery phase (before order confirmation), you can submit up to three refund requests. During the post-delivery phase (after order confirmation), you can submit up to two refund requests. If the limit is exceeded and you cannot submit a refund request, contact the merchant directly to enable the online refund option. The boundary between pre-delivery and post-delivery is defined by order confirmation (receipt confirmation).  

Details of reverse requests are as follows: payStatus refers to the order status (orderStatus).  

**Pre-delivery (receipt not confirmed, payStatus = 2):**  
- Refund only, logisticsStatus = 1 (not shipped), goodStatus = 4 (not shipped)  
- Refund only, logisticsStatus = 2 (shipped), goodStatus = 1 (goods not received)  
- Return and refund, goodStatus = 2 (goods received)  

**Post-delivery (receipt confirmed, payStatus = 6):**  
- Refund only, goodStatus = 2 (goods received)  
- Return and refund, goodStatus = 2 (goods received)  

**Important notice for uploading refund credentials:** Due to poor internal network conditions for some merchants, you must use Alibaba Cloud OSS service for image storage. For details, refer to: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/194635.htm

Note:  
1. If the seller denies the refund request (indicated by disputeStatus = 6 when queried via the queryRefundApplicationDetail4Distribution API), you can reinitiate a refund request by submitting a reverse modification request.

**Post-delivery phase (order confirmed, payStatus = 6):**  
- Refund-only, goodStatus = 2 (goods received)
